authors: Yingxiang Li, Tong Liu, Ting Xu
official: 官方在线 2026-09-07 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We show that investor patience shapes venture-capital (VC) investment strategies and outcomes. Through a randomized experiment with Chinese fund managers, we demonstrate that managers explicitly tailor fund duration and project holding periods to the perceived horizons of their limited partner (LP) base. We find consistent evidence in the field, exploiting a 2014 Chinese reform that opened RMB-denominated VC funds to insurers. We compare treated RMB funds to unaffected USD-denominated funds run by the same general partners (GPs), both investing in Chinese startups. Insurer entry reshaped the LP base by displacing shorter-horizon investors such as individuals. Consequently, treated funds shifted strategy toward longer holding periods and earlier-stage investments, leading to improved portfolio company exits and innovation. Our results highlight the importance of patient ultimate investors in building a successful VC ecosystem, and offer a cautionary note on the ongoing retailization of private markets.

title: The efficiency paradox of majoritarian democracy
title_zh: 多数民主的效率悖论
title_primary: 多数民主的效率悖论
title_secondary: The efficiency paradox of majoritarian democracy
authors: Barbara Luppi, Francesco Parisi
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-17 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Majoritarian democracy is widely regarded as the canonical procedure for converting heterogeneous individual preferences into collective decisions, yet its welfare properties are far more fragile than legal and political theorists suggest. This paper contributes to the literature on the limits of majoritarianism by applying a spatial voting model to demonstrate that the conditions under which majoritarian democracies produce efficient outcomes are narrowly constrained by the structural features of majority rule itself. We formalize a multidimensional policy environment in which voters bargain over both the policy vector and lump‑sum transfers. We show that—even with transferable utility among members of the majority coalitions—the equilibrium chosen by the pivotal majority is generally off the Pareto frontier. Taken together, these results establish an impossibility theorem for majority rule in multidimensional policy spaces: whether coalitions are stable or cyclical, simple majority voting fails to maximize aggregate welfare. Political externalities imposed on minorities systematically exceed the surplus gains accruing to decisive majorities, and vote trading cannot redress the loss. Institutional remedies—supermajority thresholds, agenda control, or issue-bundling constraints—are therefore necessary conditions for approaching efficiency under democratic decision-making.
abstract_zh: 多数主义民主被广泛视为将异质性个体偏好转化为集体决策的典范程序，然而其福利属性远比法律与政治理论家所认为的更为脆弱。本文通过应用空间投票模型，论证了多数主义民主产生有效结果的条件受到多数规则自身结构特征的严格限制，从而为关于多数主义局限性的文献做出贡献。我们形式化了一个多维政策环境，其中选民就政策向量与一次性转移支付进行讨价还价。我们证明——即使在多数联盟成员之间具有可转移效用的情形下——由关键多数所选择的均衡通常偏离帕累托前沿。综合来看，这些结果确立了多维政策空间中多数规则的不可能性定理：无论联盟是稳定的还是循环的，简单多数投票均无法最大化总体福利。施加于少数群体的政治外部性系统性超过决定性多数所获得的剩余收益，且选票交易无法弥补这一损失。因此，制度性补救措施——如超级多数门槛、议程控制或议题捆绑约束——是民主决策接近效率的必要条件。

title: A Simple Transformation Approach to Difference-in-Differences Estimation for Panel Data
title_zh: 面板数据双重差分估计的一种简单变换方法
title_primary: 面板数据双重差分估计的一种简单变换方法
title_secondary: A Simple Transformation Approach to Difference-in-Differences Estimation for Panel Data
authors: Soo Jeong Lee, Jeffrey M. Wooldridge
official: 官方在线 2026-08-06 · 来源：RSS
abstract: In the case of panel data with staggered interventions, we propose a simple time-series transformation that can be combined with various treatment effect estimators. The transformation is at the unit level, and simply requires computing the average outcome prior to an intervention, subtracting it from a post-treatment outcome, and then carefully selecting the control units in each time period. We show that under no anticipation and parallel trends assumptions, the cohort treatment indicators satisfy the key unconfoundedness assumption with respect to the transformed potential outcome. Given identification, any number of treatment effect estimators, including matching estimators, can be applied for each treated cohort and calendar time pair where the average treatment effects on the treated are identified. The doubly robust method of combining inverse probability weighting with linear regression adjustment works particularly well in terms of bias and efficiency. Importantly, our transformation is easily modified to account for unit-specific trends, allowing relaxation of the parallel trends assumption even after conditioning on covariates.
abstract_zh: 在交错干预的面板数据情形下，我们提出了一种简单的时间序列变换，可与多种处理效应估计量结合使用。该变换在单位层面进行，仅需计算干预前的平均结果，从干预后的结果中减去该平均值，并在每个时间段仔细选择对照组单位。我们证明，在无预期效应和平行趋势假设下，队列处理指标相对于变换后的潜在结果满足关键的无混淆性假设。在识别成立的前提下，任何数量的处理效应估计量，包括匹配估计量，均可应用于每个处理队列与日历时间配对，其中处理组的平均处理效应可被识别。将逆概率加权与线性回归调整相结合的双稳健方法在偏差和效率方面表现尤为出色。重要的是，我们的变换易于调整以考虑单位特定趋势，从而即使在协变量条件下也能放宽平行趋势假设。

title: Covered Interest Parity: The Long Run Evidence

authors: Olivier Accominotti, Jason Cen, David Chambers, Victor Degorce
official: 官方在线 2026-08-04 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Employing a novel daily dataset for 19 advanced-economy currencies over the years 1963–2025, we find that, contrary to the prevailing view, deviations from the covered interest parity (CIP) condition were both large and frequent over the long-run. The 2000–06 period immediately preceding the Global Financial Crisis when CIP held unusually closely is therefore the exception rather than the period that followed. The long-run pattern in CIP deviations maps closely to measures of intermediary frictions and FX swap market imbalances. Our findings indicate that intermediary frictions have been a persistent feature of international financial markets over the past six decades.
abstract_zh: 利用1963年至2025年间19种发达经济体货币的新型日度数据集，我们发现，与主流观点相反，长期来看，对抛补利率平价（CIP）条件的偏离既大且频繁。因此，全球金融危机前夕的2000-06年期间，CIP异常紧密成立，实属例外，而非后续时期的常态。CIP偏离的长期模式与中介摩擦及外汇掉期市场失衡的度量紧密对应。我们的研究结果表明，过去六十年间，中介摩擦一直是国际金融市场的持久特征。

abstract: this paper we analyze for the first time the economic impact of industrial robots, using new data on a panel of industries in 17 countries from 1993-2007. We find that industrial robots increased both labor productivity and value added. Our panel identification is robust to numerous controls, and we find similar results instrumenting increased robot use with a measure of workers? replaceability by robots, which is based on the tasks prevalent in industries before robots were widely employed. We calculate that the increased use of robots raised countries? average growth rates by about 0.37 percentage points. We also find that robots increased both wages and total factor productivity. While robots had no significant effect on total hours worked, there is some evidence that they reduced the hours of both low-skilled and middle-skilled workers.
abstract_zh: 本文首次利用1993年至2007年间17个国家行业面板的新数据，分析了工业机器人的经济影响。我们发现工业机器人提高了劳动生产率及附加值。我们的面板识别方法在众多控制变量下依然稳健，并且通过使用基于机器人广泛采用前各行业任务特征的工人可替代性度量作为工具变量，我们得到了相似的结果。计算显示，机器人的增加使用使各国平均增长率提高了约0.37个百分点。我们还发现机器人提升了工资和全要素生产率。尽管机器人对总工作时间没有显著影响，但有证据表明它们减少了低技能和中技能工人的工作时间。

title: The ripple effect of misconduct: ESG incidents and supply chain disruption risk
title_zh: 不当行为的涟漪效应：ESG事件与供应链中断风险
title_primary: 不当行为的涟漪效应：ESG事件与供应链中断风险
title_secondary: The ripple effect of misconduct: ESG incidents and supply chain disruption risk
authors: Linlin Ye, Hua Shang, Chao Tu
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-28 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Supply chain disruption is a critical operational risk, yet how ESG misconduct affects supply chain stability remains underexplored. Using a BERT-based measure of supply chain disruption risk constructed from MD&A disclosures of Chinese listed firms, we find that ESG incidents significantly elevate supply chain disruption risk. This effect operates primarily through the customer channel, while supplier relationships remain largely unaffected. This asymmetry is consistent with customers facing lower switching costs and being more sensitive to supplier reputation. Quantile regressions reveal that the effect is more pronounced among firms already facing elevated supply chain risk. Cross-sectionally, the effect is stronger for smaller firms, non-state-owned enterprises, heavy-pollution industries, and periods of economic downturns. Community-oriented, diversity-related, and product-oriented CSR activities buffer ESG-induced supply chain risk, whereas environmental management and employee relations efforts do not, indicating that externally visible CSR carries insurance value. The effect persists approximately one to two years and ultimately impairs operating performance. Our findings identify ESG incidents as an important yet manageable driver of supply chain instability and highlight the strategic value of proactive ESG management and targeted CSR investment in sustaining supply chain resilience. KEYWORDS: ESG incidents supply chain disruption risk corporate social responsibility reputational contagion JEL CLASSIFICATION: G32 M14 L14
abstract_zh: 供应链中断是一种关键运营风险，但ESG不当行为如何影响供应链稳定性仍未被充分探讨。基于中国上市公司MD&A披露文本构建的BERT供应链中断风险度量指标，我们发现ESG事件显著提升了供应链中断风险。这一效应主要通过客户渠道传导，而供应商关系基本不受影响。这种非对称性与客户面临较低转换成本且对供应商声誉更为敏感的特征一致。分位数回归显示，在已面临较高供应链风险的企业中，该效应更为显著。横截面分析表明，该效应在规模较小企业、非国有企业、重污染行业以及经济下行时期更为突出。社区导向、多元化相关及产品导向的CSR活动能够缓冲ESG引发的供应链风险，而环境管理与员工关系举措则无此效果，这表明外部可见的CSR具有保险价值。该效应持续约一至两年，并最终损害经营绩效。我们的研究揭示了ESG事件是供应链不稳定性的重要但可管理驱动因素，并强调了主动ESG管理与针对性CSR投资在维持供应链韧性中的战略价值。关键词：ESG事件 供应链中断风险 企业社会责任 声誉传染 JEL分类：G32 M14 L14

title: Effective tax rates, firm size and the global minimum tax
title_zh: 有效税率、企业规模与全球最低税
title_primary: 有效税率、企业规模与全球最低税
title_secondary: Effective tax rates, firm size and the global minimum tax
authors: Pierre Bachas, Anne Brockmeyer, Roel Dom, Camille Semelet
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-24 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper studies how tax expenditures shape the distribution of firm-level effective tax rates and their implications for domestic minimum taxes under the global minimum tax (GMT). Using administrative corporate tax returns from 16 countries, we document that tax expenditures are large and that effective tax rates tend to follow a hump-shaped pattern across the firm-size distribution, with particularly low rates among the largest firms. As a result, more than one quarter of the largest firms have effective tax rates below the 15-percent GMT rate, despite substantially higher statutory rates. However, firm-level simulations from five countries with data on subsidiaries of multinationals suggest that GMT-consistent domestic minimum taxes would likely generate modest revenue gains—a few percentage points of baseline CIT revenue—reflecting the small number of firms in scope and extensive deductions.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了税收支出如何塑造企业层面有效税率的分布，及其在全球最低税（GMT）下对国内最低税的影响。利用来自16个国家的行政企业纳税申报数据，我们记录了税收支出规模庞大，且有效税率在企业规模分布上呈现驼峰形模式，其中最大型企业的税率尤其偏低。因此，超过四分之一的最大型企业有效税率低于15%的GMT税率，尽管其法定税率显著更高。然而，基于五个拥有跨国子公司数据国家的企业层面模拟表明，与GMT一致的国内最低税可能仅带来适度的收入增长——约占基准企业所得税收入的几个百分点——这反映了适用企业数量有限及广泛的扣除项。

title: The Surprising Resilience of Globalization: An Examination of Claims of Economic Fragmentation
title_zh: 全球化的惊人韧性：对经济碎片化论断的考察
title_primary: 全球化的惊人韧性：对经济碎片化论断的考察
title_secondary: The Surprising Resilience of Globalization: An Examination of Claims of Economic Fragmentation
authors: Brad Setser
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Bipartisan doubts about the value of liberal trade in the US are shared by many populist European parties, who also question the value of deeper international economic integration. Yet for all the skeptical rhetoric-and real steps from the US and other advanced economies-globalization is not in retreat. Global trade continues to rise alongside global economic growth. If anything, trade has picked up since the pandemic. Widespread expectations that the global economy would fragment into rival blocks have not yet come to pass. Global flows related to corporate tax avoidance remain significant, cutting into US fiscal revenues. China's increasingly troubled domestic economy and its large-scale industrial policies risk leaving the US and its allies more, not less, reliant on Chinese supply in key sectors. The recent surge in China's trade surplus is evidence of ongoing globalization, and China's continued reliance on the world's big democracies for demand runs counter to any coherent definition of fragmentation. But increased global reliance on China for supply emerges more from China's own economic imbalances than from a healthy global division of labor. There is thus scope for policy reforms that support a healthier form of integration: notably, ending the perverse incentives in the US tax codes that undermine US production and revenues and harmonizing clean industrial policies to deepen trade among allies.
abstract_zh: 美国两党对自由贸易价值的质疑，与许多欧洲民粹主义政党的观点不谋而合，后者同样对深化国际经济一体化的意义提出疑问。然而，尽管存在种种怀疑论调——以及美国及其他发达经济体采取的实际措施——全球化并未退潮。全球贸易持续随经济增长而攀升。若说有何变化，疫情后贸易反而有所加速。关于全球经济将分裂为对立集团的普遍预期尚未成为现实。与企业避税相关的全球资金流动依然庞大，侵蚀着美国的财政收入。中国国内经济日益面临的困境及其大规模产业政策，可能使美国及其盟友在关键领域对中国供应的依赖不减反增。近期中国贸易顺差的激增，正是全球化持续进行的体现，而中国对世界主要民主国家市场的持续依赖，与任何关于“碎片化”的严谨定义背道而驰。然而，全球对中国供应的依赖增强，更多源于中国自身的经济失衡，而非健康的全球分工。因此，政策改革存在空间，以支持一种更为健康的整合形式：尤为重要的是，消除美国税法中损害本国生产与财政收入的扭曲激励，并协调清洁产业政策，以深化盟友间的贸易往来。

title: Government Trading and Efficiency in Imperfectly Competitive Financial Markets
title_zh: 不完全竞争金融市场中的政府交易与效率

authors: Daniel Neuhann, M. Sockin
official: 官方在线 2026-07-18 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We analyze how public asset purchases affect liquidity, risk sharing and intertemporal smoothing in imperfectly competitive financial markets. Even “neutral” policies, such as budget-balanced trades of risk-free debt, affect liquidity and trading efficiency. Public debt purchases worsen liquidity and risk sharing by increasing price impact, while debt sales improve risk sharing but distort intertemporal trade. “Expansionary” quantitative easing policies can thus reduce trading efficiency. We also derive quantity-based trading rules for optimal public portfolio management. These call for policy to equalize weighted measures of public and private price impact.
abstract_zh: 我们分析了在非完全竞争金融市场中，公共资产购买如何影响流动性、风险分担及跨期平滑。即便是“中性”政策，如预算平衡的无风险债务交易，也会影响流动性和交易效率。公共债务购买通过增加价格冲击效应而恶化流动性和风险分担，而债务出售虽能改善风险分担，却扭曲了跨期交易。因此，“扩张性”量化宽松政策可能降低交易效率。我们还推导了基于数量的最优公共投资组合管理交易规则，这些规则要求政策应使公共与私人价格冲击的加权度量相等。

abstract: Can broadband infrastructure serve as a catalyst for breaking intergenerational income links and promoting social mobility? This paper tries to answer this question by empirically examining the effects of broadband infrastructure on intergenerational income mobility in China. We exploit a quasi-natural experiment provided by the Broadband China Strategy (BCS) and employ a staggered difference-in-differences methodology to draw causal insights, revealing a 0.058 decrease in intergenerational income elasticity in pilot cities compared to non-pilot cities. The effect is particularly pronounced for males, cohorts born in the 1980 s, those whose fathers have rural hukou or lower levels of education, and residents in peri-urban areas surrounding major cities. Mechanism analyses suggest that the increase in intergenerational income mobility is primarily due to reshaping employment opportunities in favour of disadvantaged groups. These findings hold important implications not only for China but also for other developing countries undergoing digitalization.
abstract_zh: 宽带基础设施能否成为打破代际收入关联、促进社会流动的催化剂？本文通过实证检验宽带基础设施对中国代际收入流动性的影响来回答这一问题。我们利用"宽带中国"战略提供的准自然实验，采用交错双重差分法进行因果推断，发现试点城市的代际收入弹性较非试点城市下降了0.058。这一效应在男性、20世纪80年代出生群体、父亲为农村户籍或低学历者、以及大城市周边近郊居民中尤为显著。机制分析表明，代际收入流动性的提升主要源于就业机会向弱势群体的重新配置。这些发现不仅对中国具有重要启示，对正处于数字化转型进程中的其他发展中国家同样具有借鉴意义。

title: Property tax incidence and housing market in Taiwan
title_zh: 台湾房产税归宿与住房市场

abstract: This research consolidates three views of property tax incidence into a dynamic stochastic general equilibrium (DSGE) model and analyzes the effects of property tax shocks on housing markets. We show that the elasticity of substitution between residential housing (owner-occupied) and investment housing (non-owner-occupied) plays an important role for the incidence of the property tax. When applying the model to Taiwan’s housing tax reform, the results indicate that the implementation of a hoarding tax on investment housing fails to curb the investment housing price; the tax effect is passed on to the residential housing price when investment housing and residential housing are considered as complements. A tax on residential housing can effectively moderate residential housing consumption and residential housing prices.
abstract_zh: 本研究将财产税归宿的三种观点整合至动态随机一般均衡（DSGE）模型中，并分析了财产税冲击对住房市场的影响。研究表明，自住型住房与投资型住房（非自住型）之间的替代弹性在财产税归宿中发挥关键作用。将该模型应用于台湾地区住房税制改革时，结果显示：对投资型住房征收囤房税未能有效抑制其价格；当投资型住房与自住型住房被视为互补品时，税收效应会转嫁至自住型住房价格。对自住型住房征税则可有效调节自住型住房消费及其价格水平。

abstract: Can African countries deter industrial fishing vessels from near-shore waters reserved for artisanal fishers? Using radar data released in 2024, this paper provides the first causal evaluation of these Inshore Exclusion Zones (IEZs). Regression discontinuity estimates reveal deterrence in 6 of 20 African countries. Next, we apply bunching estimators to obtain counterfactual vessel distributions uncontaminated by spillovers outside IEZ boundaries. We capture extensive-margin effects by calibrating a discrete choice vessel location model to our bunching estimates. Bioeconomic calculations indicate that IEZs increase artisanal fisher catch by enough to meet key micronutrient requirements for 7 million people.
abstract_zh: 非洲国家能否阻止工业渔船进入为手工渔民保留的近岸水域？本文利用2024年发布的雷达数据，首次对这些近岸禁渔区（IEZs）进行了因果效应评估。断点回归估计结果显示，在20个非洲国家中有6个国家产生了威慑效应。随后，我们应用聚束估计量获取了不受禁渔区边界外溢出效应污染的反事实船舶分布。通过将离散选择船舶定位模型校准至聚束估计结果，我们捕捉了集约边际效应。生物经济核算表明，近岸禁渔区使手工渔民的渔获量增加幅度足以满足700万人的关键微量营养素需求。

abstract: How might the evidence of hoards of coins of small value shift the terms of the Great Divergence Debate? It begins by overturning Immanuel Wallerstein's (The Modern World System, Vol. 2, 1974) understanding of the inflow of American bullion and its hoarding in India/Asia. Instead, it points to the growing monetization that was at work in India/Asia from the sixteenth century.

title: Another Look at the (Ir)Relevance of Long‐Run Risks for Equity Risk Premia

title_primary: 长期风险对股权风险溢价的（不）相关性再审视

source: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
official: 官方在线 2026-06-04 · 来源：RSS
abstract: I investigate the empirical asset pricing implications of a three‐factor macro model that extends the baseline consumption model Consumption Capital Asset Pricing Model (CCAPM) by adding the innovations in expected long‐run consumption growth (consumption growth news) and expected long‐run consumption variance (variance news) as risk factors. By using a reasonable cross‐section of equity risk premia, such a model is largely rejected (both on statistical and economic grounds), as the factor risk prices are either insignificant and/or economically implausible, whereas the pricing errors are very large. Thus, long‐run consumption risks (LRR) do not rescue the CCAPM, which represents a major challenge for the voluminous LRR literature.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了一个三因子宏观模型的实证资产定价含义，该模型在基准消费模型——消费资本资产定价模型（CCAPM）的基础上，将预期长期消费增长（消费增长新闻）和预期长期消费方差（方差新闻）的冲击作为风险因子。通过使用合理的横截面股权风险溢价，该模型在统计和经济层面均被显著拒绝，因为因子风险价格要么不显著，要么在经济上不合理，而定价误差则非常大。因此，长期消费风险（LRR）未能挽救CCAPM，这对大量LRR文献构成了重大挑战。

title: Heat after the Harvest: Farmer Choices and Perceptions of Crop Residue Burning in Thailand
title_zh: 收获后的热浪：泰国农民对秸秆焚烧的选择与认知
title_primary: 收获后的热浪：泰国农民对秸秆焚烧的选择与认知
title_secondary: Heat after the Harvest: Farmer Choices and Perceptions of Crop Residue Burning in Thailand
authors: Witsanu Attavanich, Adrian A. Lopes, Sailesh Tiwari, Ajalavat Viriyavipart
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-26 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Crop residue burning (CRB) remains a persistent contributor to air pollution and environmental degradation in South and Southeast Asia, imposing significant health and productivity costs. While policies have emphasized regulatory enforcement and technological alternatives, the behavioral and socioeconomic drivers of CRB are less well understood. This study examines how farmers’ perceptions, social norms, resource access, and socioeconomic characteristics jointly relate to CRB decisions, by drawing on a conceptual framework from the agricultural literature that synthesizes behavioral dimensions of farmer practices. Using original survey data from 1,030 rice farmers in twelve subdistricts across three high-burning provinces near Bangkok, Thailand, we estimate logistic regression models that incorporate interactions between perceptions and socioeconomic aspects. Results show that perceptions—such as viewing CRB as a widespread norm and recognizing its effects on the environment, soil quality, and health—significantly relate to burning behavior; though these effects vary by farm size, education, and resource access. By modeling how perceptions interact with socioeconomic characteristics, this study advances the understanding of behavioral mechanisms and farmers’ attitudes towards environment, soil quality, health, and social aspects of CRB. The findings highlight the importance of integrating behavioral insights into policy design, aligning information dissemination with local contexts, and enabling viable alternatives to burning. Systematically accounting for farmer perceptions could offer actionable pathways for reducing CRB’s environmental impact while promoting sustainable agricultural practices in Thailand and comparable contexts.
abstract_zh: 作物残茬焚烧（CRB）仍是南亚和东南亚空气污染与环境退化的持续来源，造成巨大的健康与生产力损失。尽管政策侧重于监管执法和技术替代方案，但CRB的行为与社会经济驱动因素尚不明确。本研究基于农业文献中综合农户实践行为维度的概念框架，考察农户认知、社会规范、资源获取及社会经济特征如何共同关联于CRB决策。利用来自泰国曼谷附近三个高焚烧省份十二个分区1,030名水稻农户的原始调查数据，我们估计了纳入认知与社会经济方面交互项的逻辑回归模型。结果表明，认知——如将CRB视为普遍规范以及认识到其对环境、土壤质量和健康的影响——与焚烧行为显著相关；尽管这些效应因农场规模、教育程度和资源获取而异。通过建模认知与社会经济特征的交互作用，本研究增进了对行为机制及农户对环境、土壤质量、健康和社会层面CRB态度的理解。研究结果强调了将行为洞察纳入政策设计、使信息传播与地方情境相匹配以及提供可行焚烧替代方案的重要性。系统性地考虑农户认知可为减少CRB的环境影响提供可行路径，同时促进泰国及类似情境下的可持续农业实践。

title: Burn now or never? Climate policy exposure and investment of fossil fuel firms
title_zh: 现在燃烧还是永不燃烧？气候政策暴露与化石燃料企业投资
title_primary: 现在燃烧还是永不燃烧？气候政策暴露与化石燃料企业投资
title_secondary: Burn now or never? Climate policy exposure and investment of fossil fuel firms
authors: Jakob Feveile Adolfsen, Malte Heissel, Ana-Simona Manu, Francesca Vinci
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-15 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We investigate the impact of expectations about future climate policy on investment decisions of fossil fuel firms. Our empirical analysis reveals that within the fossil fuel industry, firms with high exposure to climate policy significantly increased their investment in response to the Paris Agreement relative to firms with low exposure. Importantly, the result is driven by traditional investment in fossil fuel exploration and extraction with no indications that firms invested in a transition towards renewable energy production, nor in reducing the carbon-intensity of fossil fuel production. Our findings contribute to the ongoing discussion about the potential adverse effects of delaying the implementation of planned climate regulation.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了关于未来气候政策预期对化石燃料企业投资决策的影响。实证分析显示，在化石燃料行业内，相较于气候政策暴露度较低的企业，暴露度高的企业在《巴黎协定》后显著增加了投资。重要的是，这一结果主要由对化石燃料勘探与开采的传统投资驱动，并未发现企业投资转向可再生能源生产或降低化石燃料生产碳强度的迹象。我们的发现为当前关于推迟实施既定气候监管可能带来的不利影响的讨论提供了参考。

title: Step into action: how reminders shape engagement in fitness apps
title_zh: 步入行动：提醒如何塑造健身应用中的用户参与度
title_primary: 步入行动：提醒如何塑造健身应用中的用户参与度
title_secondary: Step into action: how reminders shape engagement in fitness apps
authors: Beatrice Braut, Claire Mollier, Sarah Zaccagni
official: 官方在线 2026-05-11 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Regular exercise offers well‐documented health benefits, and mobile applications are increasingly used to promote physical activity. In this study, we conduct a large‐scale randomized controlled trial with 20,187 users of the WeWard app in France to evaluate the effectiveness of different message framings and intervention durations on app engagement and walking behaviour. Participants were randomly assigned to receive one of three types of messages, each leveraging distinct behavioural features such as peer comparison, self‐comparison or a generic reminder, over a period of one or three weeks. Our results show that peer‐comparison messages positively influence the extensive margin of app utilization. However, despite these increases in app usage, neither type of message led to a significant increase in the number of steps walked. These findings highlight the limitations of relying on engagement metrics alone when evaluating app‐based interventions aimed at behaviour change.
abstract_zh: 规律运动对健康有明确益处，而移动应用程序正越来越多地被用于促进体育活动。本研究在法国WeWard应用的20,187名用户中开展大规模随机对照试验，评估不同信息框架和干预时长对应用参与度及步行行为的影响。参与者被随机分配接收三种类型的信息（分别利用同伴比较、自我比较或通用提醒等不同行为特征），干预周期为一周或三周。结果显示，同伴比较信息对应用使用的广延边际产生正向影响。然而，尽管应用使用频率有所提升，但各类信息均未显著增加步行步数。这些发现揭示了在评估基于应用的行为改变干预措施时，仅依赖参与度指标的局限性。

title: Improving the Finite Sample Estimation of Average Treatment Effects Using Double/Debiased Machine Learning With Propensity Score Calibration
title_zh: 使用倾向得分校准的双重/去偏机器学习改进平均处理效应的有限样本估计
title_primary: 使用倾向得分校准的双重/去偏机器学习改进平均处理效应的有限样本估计
title_secondary: Improving the Finite Sample Estimation of Average Treatment Effects Using Double/Debiased Machine Learning With Propensity Score Calibration
authors: Daniele Ballinari, Nora Bearth
official: 官方在线 2026-05-08 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Double/debiased machine learning (DML) uses for estimating an average treatment effect (ATE) a double‐robust score function that relies on the prediction of nuisance functions, such as the propensity score, which is the probability of treatment assignment given covariates. Estimators relying on double‐robust score functions are highly sensitive to errors in propensity score predictions. Machine learning algorithms have been found to produce models that often overestimate or underestimate these probabilities. Several calibration approaches have been proposed to improve probabilistic forecasts of machine learners. This paper explores their integration into the DML framework, showing via simulations that using calibrated propensity scores significantly reduces the root mean squared error of ATE estimates in finite samples while preserving DML's asymptotic properties.
abstract_zh: 双重/去偏机器学习（DML）利用双稳健得分函数来估计平均处理效应（ATE），该函数依赖于对干扰函数的预测，例如倾向得分——即在给定协变量条件下接受处理的概率。依赖双稳健得分函数的估计量对倾向得分预测中的误差高度敏感。研究发现，机器学习算法生成的模型往往高估或低估这些概率。已有多种校准方法被提出以改进机器学习模型的概率预测。本文探讨了将这些方法整合到DML框架中的可行性，并通过模拟实验证明：在校准倾向得分后，有限样本中ATE估计的均方根误差显著降低，同时DML的渐近性质得以保持。

title: Measuring forest-related depth in preferential trade agreements: the forest provisions depth index
title_zh: 优惠贸易协定中森林相关深度的测量：森林条款深度指数
title_primary: 优惠贸易协定中森林相关深度的测量：森林条款深度指数
title_secondary: Measuring forest-related depth in preferential trade agreements: the forest provisions depth index
authors: Michelle Márcia Viana Martins, Alan Leal, Rodrigo Fagundes Cezar
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-07 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Trade agreements have become a vehicle for environmental commitments, but existing measures of environmental provisions in preferential trade agreements do not distinguish forest-specific content from general environmental architecture. This paper introduces the Forest Provisions Depth Index (FPDI), a composite indicator measuring the depth of forest-related commitments in preferential trade agreements across three dimensions: explicit forest content, implementation and compliance capacity, and normative anchoring. The index covers 778 agreements involving 213 countries from 1947 to 2021, uses geometric aggregation with a targeted discount when forest-specific clauses are absent, and is stock-based, accumulating provisions across a country’s in-force agreement portfolio. Country rankings are stable across 11 alternative weighting schemes, and the composite shows moderate correlation with a cumulative forest-clause count, indicating it captures treaty architecture beyond clause frequency. Panel estimates on 150 countries over 2002 to 2021 associate governance capacity, forest rents, and wood product imports with higher FPDI scores, while tree-cover loss and agricultural land expansion associate with lower scores. Persistent cross-country governance differences account for more FPDI variation than within-country changes, and agricultural expansion operates through the within-country margin. The FPDI provides a benchmark for cross-country comparison of treaty design and for research on trade-forest linkages.
abstract_zh: 贸易协定已成为环境承诺的载体，但现有对特惠贸易协定中环境条款的度量并未区分森林特定内容与一般环境架构。本文引入森林条款深度指数（FPDI），这是一个综合指标，用于衡量特惠贸易协定中森林相关承诺的深度，涵盖三个维度：明确的森林内容、实施与合规能力，以及规范性锚定。该指数覆盖1947年至2021年间涉及213个国家的778项协定，采用几何聚合方法，并在缺乏森林特定条款时施加定向折扣，且基于存量计算，累积一国现行协定组合中的条款。国家排名在11种替代权重方案下保持稳定，且该综合指数与累计森林条款数量呈中度相关，表明其捕捉了超越条款频率的条约架构。基于2002年至2021年150个国家的面板估计显示，治理能力、森林租金和木材产品进口与较高的FPDI得分相关，而树冠覆盖损失和农业用地扩张则与较低得分相关。国家间持续的治理差异对FPDI变异的解释力大于国家内部变化，而农业扩张则通过国家内部边际发挥作用。FPDI为跨国比较条约设计及研究贸易与森林关联提供了基准。

title: Bank concentration, product market competition and productivity growth
title_zh: 银行集中度、产品市场竞争与生产率增长
title_primary: 银行集中度、产品市场竞争与生产率增长
title_secondary: Bank concentration, product market competition and productivity growth
authors: Lei Ye
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-07 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: U.S. product markets have become more concentrated since the late 1990s, with higher markups, weaker entry, and slower productivity growth. This paper studies whether consolidation in the U.S. banking sector has contributed to these trends. Empirically, I show that higher bank concentration is associated with rising product market markups, lower entry, and a reallocation of market power toward large incumbents. I interpret these patterns in a quantitative endogenous growth model with imperfect bank competition and heterogeneous firms. The key mechanism is a widening loan-deposit spread: even as interest rate levels decline, greater bank market power increases the wedge between the borrowing costs faced by small bank-dependent firms and the opportunity cost of funds faced by large internally financed firms, shifting competition toward large incumbents and weakening innovation incentives. In calibrated counterfactuals, the rise in bank concentration explains about 14% of the increase in product market concentration and 5% of the slowdown in productivity growth over the post-2000 period.
abstract_zh: 自20世纪90年代末以来，美国产品市场集中度上升，伴随更高的加成率、更弱的市场进入以及生产率增长放缓。本文研究美国银行业整合是否对这些趋势有所贡献。实证上，我表明更高的银行集中度与产品市场加成率上升、进入减少以及市场力量向大型在位企业重新分配相关联。我在一个包含不完全银行竞争和异质性企业的定量内生增长模型中解释这些模式。关键机制在于贷款-存款利差的扩大：即使利率水平下降，更大的银行市场力量增加了小型依赖银行的企业所面临的借款成本与大型内部融资企业所面临的资金机会成本之间的差距，从而将竞争转向大型在位企业并削弱创新激励。在校准的反事实分析中，银行集中度的上升解释了2000年后产品市场集中度增加的大约14%以及生产率增长放缓的5%。

title: Local Networks and New Business Formation
title_zh: 本地网络与新企业形成
title_primary: 本地网络与新企业形成
title_secondary: Local Networks and New Business Formation
authors: Lena Füner, Marius Berger, Johannes Bersch, Hanna Hottenrott
official: 官方在线 2026-04-28 · 来源：RSS
abstract: New business formation is a key driver of regional transformation and development. While we know that a region's attractiveness for new businesses depends on its resources, infrastructure, and human capital, we know little about the role of local business networks in promoting or impeding the birth of new firms. We construct local business networks connecting more than 350 million nodes consisting of managers, owners, and firms using data on the universe of German businesses. Differentiating between firms founded by serial and de novo entrepreneurs and different network measures (average degree and transitivity of the largest component), we show that the connectedness between actors within a region matters for firm entry and individual firm performance. We show a positive relationship between a region's connectedness and firm entry by serial entrepreneurs. Networks are also linked to individual firm performance, especially in terms of larger entry size of de-novo firms and higher employment growth for both de-novo and serial entrepreneurship.
abstract_zh: 新企业创建是区域转型与发展的关键驱动力。尽管我们已知一个地区对新企业的吸引力取决于其资源、基础设施和人力资本，但对于本地商业网络在促进或阻碍新企业诞生中所扮演的角色，我们知之甚少。我们利用德国全部企业的数据，构建了连接超过3.5亿个节点（包括经理、所有者及企业）的本地商业网络。通过区分连续创业者和新创企业家所创立的企业，并采用不同的网络指标（最大连通分量的平均度与传递性），我们揭示了区域内行为者之间的连接性对企业进入及个体企业绩效的影响。研究显示，区域连接性与连续创业者的企业进入之间存在正相关关系。网络还与个体企业绩效相关联，尤其体现在新创企业更大的初始规模以及新创和连续创业企业更高的就业增长上。

title: The Walker–Groves–Ledyard mechanism: Improving individual rationality without sacrificing simplicity or stability
title_zh: Walker–Groves–Ledyard机制：在不牺牲简洁性或稳定性的前提下提升个体理性
title_primary: Walker–Groves–Ledyard机制：在不牺牲简洁性或稳定性的前提下提升个体理性
title_secondary: The Walker–Groves–Ledyard mechanism: Improving individual rationality without sacrificing simplicity or stability
authors: Paul J. Healy, Renkun Yang
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-02-27 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: It is known that no public goods mechanism can be Pareto efficient in Nash equilibrium, individually rational (IR), simple (using a one-dimensional message space), and dynamically stable. The Walker mechanism satisfies all but stability, while the Groves–Ledyard mechanism satisfies all but IR. Here we show that a hybrid between these two mechanisms maintains all of the properties of the Groves–Ledyard mechanism, but with fewer IR failures in expectation.
abstract_zh: 众所周知，没有任何公共品机制能在纳什均衡中同时实现帕累托效率、个体理性（IR）、简单性（使用一维信息空间）以及动态稳定性。Walker机制满足除稳定性外的所有条件，而Groves–Ledyard机制则满足除个体理性外的所有条件。在此，我们展示这两种机制的混合体保留了Groves–Ledyard机制的所有性质，但在预期中减少了个体理性失效的情况。

title: Developmental Role of Negative Feedback
title_zh: 负反馈的发展性作用
title_primary: 负反馈的发展性作用
title_secondary: Developmental Role of Negative Feedback
authors: Kimiyuki Morita
official: 官方在线 2025-11-24 · 来源：RSS
abstract: I develop a model that investigates the developmental role of negative feedback, where a worker can improve his skills after receiving feedback from a supervisor. The supervisor faces a trade-off: negative feedback promotes skill development, while positive feedback preserves the worker's confidence. The analysis shows that negative feedback is provided when skill development succeeds with sufficiently high probability. A key result is that while the supervisor with higher evaluation ability has stronger incentives to conceal bad news, her higher ability to detect it prevails, implying greater provision of negative feedback. These findings offer managerial implications for mentoring practices.
abstract_zh: 我构建了一个模型，探讨负面反馈在发展中的作用，即员工在收到主管反馈后能够提升自身技能。主管面临权衡：负面反馈促进技能发展，而正面反馈则维护员工信心。分析表明，当技能发展成功的概率足够高时，会提供负面反馈。一个关键结果是，尽管评估能力更强的主管更有动机隐瞒坏消息，但其更高的识别能力占据上风，意味着负面反馈的提供更为充分。这些发现为辅导实践提供了管理启示。

title: A Bayesian Stochastic Discount Factor for the Cross-Section of Individual Equity Options
title_zh: 个体股票期权横截面中的贝叶斯随机贴现因子
title_primary: 个体股票期权横截面中的贝叶斯随机贴现因子
title_secondary: A Bayesian Stochastic Discount Factor for the Cross-Section of Individual Equity Options
authors: Käfer, Niclas, Mörke, Mathis, Weigert 等
source: Journal of Financial and Quantitative Analysis
official: 官方在线 2025-10-06 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We utilize Bayesian model averaging to estimate a stochastic discount factor (SDF) for single-stock options. A Bayesian model averaging SDF outperforms reduced-form benchmark models in-sample and out-of-sample in pricing option return anomalies and portfolios. We document that the SDF is dense in characteristics with the implied-realized volatility spread, option return momentum, and jump risk emerging as the most likely included factors. The option SDF exhibits a distinct business cycle pattern and aligns more closely with its counterpart in the stock market than in the bond market.
abstract_zh: 我们采用贝叶斯模型平均法来估计个股期权的随机贴现因子（SDF）。贝叶斯模型平均SDF在样本内和样本外均优于简化形式的基准模型，在期权回报异常和组合定价方面表现更佳。我们记录到，该SDF在特征上密集，其中隐含-已实现波动率差、期权回报动量及跳跃风险成为最可能被纳入的因素。期权SDF展现出独特的商业周期模式，并且与股票市场中的对应SDF相比，与债券市场的对应SDF更为一致。

title: Preference diversity
title_zh: 偏好多样性
title_primary: 偏好多样性
title_secondary: Preference diversity
authors: Matthias Ammann, Clemens Puppe
official: 官方在线 2025-07-04 · 来源：RSS
abstract: How can we assess the diversity of a group of decision makers? Identifying decision makers with their preferences, we address this question by applying the multi-attribute approach developed by Nehring and Puppe (2002) to sets of preferences. Specifically, we provide a repertoire of alternative models to measure the diversity of sets of preferences. The proposed models are purely ordinal and are characterized in terms of the different properties that a preference order need to satisfy in order to contribute to the diversity of a given set of preference orderings.
abstract_zh: 如何评估一组决策者的多样性？通过将决策者与其偏好相对应，我们运用Nehring和Puppe（2002）发展的多属性方法来解决这一问题，并将其应用于偏好集合。具体而言，我们提供了一系列替代模型来衡量偏好集合的多样性。所提出的模型纯属序数性质，并通过偏好序需满足的不同属性来刻画，这些属性决定了偏好序对给定偏好序集合多样性的贡献。
